purpose: Final offline SPECTRA agent split over the 287-file checkpoint pool. Train never sees every checkpoint. ImageNet and ViT/DeiT are not in the DRL fine-tune loop.
cnn_loadable_target: Every CNN checkpoint should load after the akamaster option-A and RepVGG deploy remaps. Grafting / DeiT / ViT / MaxViT stay out of SPECTRA catalogs (not structured-CNN prune targets).

split_rule.train: At least one competent net per (family x cheap-dataset) combo we actually have. Cheap datasets = CIFAR-10, SVHN, Fashion-MNIST. CIFAR-100 joins train only after a 2-5% structured cut recovers inside -10 pp.
split_rule.eval_similar: Same families, different width / depth / source (thin vs chenyaofo vs akamaster). This is the in-distribution generalizability claim.
split_rule.eval_novel: Families absent from train (ShuffleNet, RepVGG) on a dataset the agent did train on (CIFAR-10). This is the unlike-architecture claim.
split_rule.eval_heldout_dataset: CIFAR-100 nets, listed separately, once recovery exists. ImageNet CNNs are a later transfer catalog with no overnight fine-tune.

database_c10_thin_plus_skinny.json.note: C10-thin train plus skinny r20-w2. Held-out test is r56-w4 only (input_c10_width_heldout.json). Does not replace the leap catalog.

database_offline_wide.json.note: 10-net leap catalog plus extra C10 widths/sources/families. Similar/novel/C10-thin eval files stay held out. No C100, no ImageNet, no grafting/MNIST toys.

database_c100_wide.json.note: Start only after a recipe probe cell is inside -10 pp (afterok).

input_offline_imagenet.json.note: Never overnight FT. Load and prune with frozen or short eval only.
